ep3-absurdist-1.speaker: Clancy
ep3-absurdist-1.text: Ice cream, there's got to be a planet with ice cream.

ep3-absurdist-2.speaker: Simulator
ep3-absurdist-2.text: My rapidly deteriorating sensors have honed in on this magical fishbowl man.

ep3-absurdist-3.speaker: Clancy
ep3-absurdist-3.text: Captain, you got any ice cream on this big fun boat?

ep3-phil-q1.speaker: Clancy
ep3-phil-q1.text: What are the roots of magic?

ep3-phil-a1.speaker: Fishbowl Man
ep3-phil-a1.text: You know, magic, ceremonial magic, what we call high magic, originated in ancient Mesopotamia somewhere around 3500 BC.

ep3-phil-q2.speaker: Clancy
ep3-phil-q2.text: Is it the words that have the energy, or is it the energy coming out of the person saying the words?

ep3-phil-a2.speaker: Fishbowl Man
ep3-phil-a2.text: Combination of both. For example, you can only pass the current if you've received the current.

ep3-phil-q3.speaker: Clancy
ep3-phil-q3.text: Do you think that the reason you ended up in prison is because, this sounds so weird, good karma?

ep3-phil-a3.speaker: Fishbowl Man
ep3-phil-a3.text: Yes. This will sound crazy to people, but I absolutely do. I am thankful now for the time that I spent in prison.

ep3-conclusion.speaker: Darryl
ep3-conclusion.text: Behold the death of the old eon... and the birth of the new.
